question: Do flat counters after capture prove consumer/restore phases cannot rerun a native owner?
setup: Invoke an existing native owner after the producer capture context has exited; independent measurement control, not the normal migration case
finding: Delegating capture hooks are removed after orchestration. Counter equality alone cannot detect later domain calls.
correction: During consumers and restore, explicitly reject producer/orchestrator and native-owner calls through current application/domain aliases. Count equality is secondary; preserve independent native state/material-input oracles.
